common.readOnlyHint: Read-only – editing requires the master data management role.
common.deactivateDescription: The record will be deactivated and is no longer available for new processes. Existing references are kept. Records that were never referenced are deleted permanently.

parts.title: Parts
parts.description: Own parts with part number, name and drawing revision.
parts.newDescription: The part number is the business key and cannot be changed later.
parts.emptyDescription: Create parts individually or import a CSV/Excel file.
parts.name: Name
parts.catenaXIdHint: Optional, format urn:uuid:…, used for the digital twin

partners.title: Partners
partners.description: Customers and suppliers with BPNL and connector endpoint.
partners.newDescription: The BPNL is the business key. Your own tenant cannot be added as a partner.
partners.emptyDescription: Add customers and suppliers to exchange approvals with them.
partners.name: Name
partners.rolesHint: From your company's point of view
partners.dspEndpointHint: Protocol endpoint of the partner EDC, e.g. https://…/api/v1/dsp/2025-1
partners.exchangeReadyHint: DSP endpoint and DID are set – sending via EDC is possible.
partners.exchangeNotReadyHint: DSP endpoint or DID missing: the partner can be saved but not used for sending.

sites.title: Sites
sites.description: Manufacturing and delivery sites (BPNS) of your company and your partners.
sites.newDescription: The BPNS is the business key.
sites.emptyDescription: Add sites to assign delivery and receiving plants.
sites.name: Name

relations.title: Relationships
relations.description: Customer and supplier relationships with exchange mode and part mappings.
relations.newDescription: At most one relationship per partner and role.
relations.emptyDescription: Relationships connect your company with customers and suppliers and map part numbers.

partMappings.title: Part mappings
partMappings.description: Own part number ↔ partner part number, optionally with delivery and receiving plant.
partMappings.emptyDescription: Map your parts to the partner's part numbers.
partMappings.removeDescription: The mapping will be deleted permanently.

catalog.title: Element catalogue
catalog.description: Submission elements, submission levels with requirement matrix and submission reasons.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.codeHint: Stable key for exchange with partners, e.g. VDA-PPF-09

elements.emptyDescription: The catalogue is normally loaded from the seed at start-up.
elements.valueSchemaHint: Optional. JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for structured values, e.g. a Cpk list.

levels.emptyDescription: Create submission levels (e.g. VDA level 0–4, AIAG level 1–5).
levels.matrixDescription: Which elements each level requires. Changes are saved per level.

reasons.emptyDescription: Submission reasons are e.g. new part, product change or change of supplier.

matrix.keyboardHint: Arrow keys: move between cells · Enter: open choices · 1/2/3: required / on request / not required
matrix.empty: The matrix needs elements and levels.

audit.title: Change history
audit.description: Immutable audit entries, chained per record with SHA-256.
